goal: Test one RFF RBF logistic classifier on the original frozen 2018-2023 training rows and the full exposed 2024 evaluation fold.
hypothesis: A fixed 256-dimensional RBF random-feature map with equal-weight L2 logistic classification may improve the frozen 2024 Top3 ranking while retaining the original data, row order, candidate pool, controls, labels, and evaluation helpers.
one_variable: Replace the original XENDCG learner with train-only mean imputation/standardization, fixed RFF-RBF(256,gamma=1/64,seed=42), and equal-weight L2 logistic regression C=1.

input_identity.feature_set_and_order: exactly the original frozen 64-column FULL64 order
input_identity.training_fold: original 2018-2023 eligible/mature/purged rows, all rows retained
input_identity.evaluation_fold: full exposed 2024 grid, original Top3 helper, 246 sessions and 738 slots

preprocessing.missing_value_rule: per-feature train mean; all-NaN train feature mean is 0; then standardize
preprocessing.standardization: train-only population mean/std; zero or non-finite std becomes 1; evaluation uses frozen train statistics

random_fourier_features.draw_order: normal projection W [64,256] with scale sqrt(2*gamma), then uniform phase b [256] in [0,2*pi)
random_fourier_features.chunking: fixed 4096-row transform chunks; one preallocated training RFF matrix; evaluation projected in chunks after the training matrix is released

learner.sample_weights: all ones; no class, episode, day, or control weights
learner.nonconvergence: STOP_OPTIMIZER_NOT_CONVERGED; record full OptimizeResult; no changed options, retry, or evaluation

prediction_and_evaluation.prediction: one public full-S call; internal fixed transform chunks do not create extra model-predict calls
prediction_and_evaluation.ranking_score: raw logistic decision margin; original raw-ranking-score AP/Top3 path
prediction_and_evaluation.event_probability: sigmoid(raw margin) emitted by the fitted logistic classifier; no separate calibrator
prediction_and_evaluation.evaluator: original accepted score-aware and episode metric helpers; original PLUS and BASE34 controls unchanged

resources.monitor: existing sampled resource monitor; sampling is not a hard peak guarantee

stop_rule: Any identity, row/schema, resource, optimizer convergence, execution accounting, sealing, or evaluation mismatch fails closed; no second fit, modified solver, alternate seed, or follow-on candidate.
